skeleton_policy: The accepted Meshy rig is the sole v8 skeletal base. Every final action retains substantive motion from the named meshy_animate action or the rig-included walking source. Blender may only retarget, clean, contact-correct, normalize, bake, synchronize, export, and reimport.
root_policy: in_place except contact-corrected death collapse; keyed location scaling is applied deliberately exactly once during retarget if source units differ

actions.required_evidence: breathing and alert head/torso motion with stable two-hand mace grip
multi-step gait, alternating feet, ground contacts, in-place correction
two-handed windup, downswing, impact phase, recoil and recovery
weapon lowered into guarded observation and returned without grip break
distinct multi-strike support sequence with recovery
backward stepping cycle, crouched defensive posture, stable contacts
repeated weighted two-hand swing with exertion phase and recovery
impact reaction, articulated collapse, ground contact and terminal settling

forbidden: author_humanoid_actions as a final action source
semantic reuse of one action for another
weapon grip repair that replaces substantive provider motion

sound_sync.selection: unit selection or acknowledgement trigger; not action-frame-bound
sound_sync.movement: move foot-contact phases after provider frame inspection
sound_sync.idle_vocal: idle alert/breath peak after provider frame inspection
sound_sync.maul_swing: attack downswing begins after provider frame inspection
sound_sync.heavy_impact: attack contact frame after provider frame inspection
sound_sync.training: training exertion apex after provider frame inspection
sound_sync.death: death collapse onset or ground impact after provider frame inspection
